replacements.La petición entra desde el cliente, espe: The request arrives from the client, waits in a queue, and enters prefill. Prefill processes the prompt, builds the KV cache, and enables the first output. Decode reuses and extends that state over successive steps until the response completes. The TTFT bracket spans network, queueing, prefill, and first delivery. TPOT characterizes the interval after the first token according to the benchmark definition. A concurrency lane applies pressure to the scheduler: more batching can raise throughput while also moving TTFT or TPOT.

replacements.<strong>La primera salida divide dos pro: The first output separates two different problems. Client-observed TTFT spans more than prefill: it can include network, queueing, scheduling, and delivery. Decode then repeats work over reusable state, and TPOT/ITL describe that cadence only under the benchmark's formula. Throughput belongs to the population: batching and concurrency can improve utilization while also worsening per-request latency. The latency budget therefore has to preserve both client/server and prefill/decode boundaries.
